confidence_notes: Recent aggregated Wellington cost data anchors meals, cappuccino and domestic draft beer. Wine is informed by a New Zealand restaurant price range and a current Wellington menu; cocktail is estimated at about 1.4 times the draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listing checks and is the least certain part.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city was used; food and drink anchors use Wellington-specific data, while accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Wellington as a small national capital.
